extraction_boundary: WP-007 cycle 2 extracts candidate requirements from exactly one named historical source, HS-011, the ULW-AS-001 v1.3 accessibility acceptance contract as carried in this repository at docs/ACCESSIBILITY_ACCEPTANCE.md, bound to commit 6e447103fcb65c2054d2080a12847777960a4642. Every normative sentence and every table row of that document is extracted; nothing outside that file is read, and no second source is opened. Candidates are pre-disposition records: no owner disposition, no conformance state, and no implementation, testing, release, or claimability meaning is attached to any record.
source_selection_rationale: The owner named a verified August 5, 2026 clean-room v0.2 source as preferred if genuinely reachable. It is not reachable through the repository's governed source mechanism: the only clean-room packages recorded anywhere in the repository are the v0.15-v0.23 Drive ZIPs listed in docs/wp-006/DRIVE_REPOSITORY_AUTHORITY_MAP.md line 39, which are held under HS-018/HS-019, carry access_limitation NOT-ACCESSIBLE-TO-EXECUTOR and version_or_hash NOT-AVAILABLE, and whose import is recorded as prohibited. No repository artifact dated August 5, 2026 or versioned v0.2 exists as a requirement source, so no such source was opened, inferred, or simulated. The next highest-authority reachable HIGH-relevance source was selected: HS-011. Among reachable HIGH sources, HS-003 and HS-011 are both HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE while HS-006 is RESEARCH-INPUT and HS-005 is REFERENCE-ONLY; of the two HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE sources, HS-003 is a current-state report about the repository, whereas HS-011 is the only reachable source that carries adopted-standard normative requirement wording, which is the material this cycle exists to recover. HS-011 is recorded PARTIAL because only the repository-carried excerpt is reachable; that limitation is inherited by every record and no claim is made about the upstream full standard.
